summary: Adversarial review of tests/test_agents_loop.py (whole 3-agent loop in a FakeRoom)
prompt: You are an adversarial reviewer. Deliverable under review: tests/test_agents_loop.py - the whole StranglerRoom loop in-process: tests/fakes.py FakeRoom hosting the REAL agents/translator_agent.py, agents/fuzzer_agent.py and agents/cutover_agent.py, with real legacy, modern (reloader ON, tmp MODERN_LISTS_PATH) and proxy subprocesses on free ports (tests/procs.py). Verify it against docs/AGENTS_SPEC.md (sections 2 and 3) and docs/SPEC.md line by line; run it (`.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_agents_loop.py`, several times) and the agent suites (`.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_translator_agent.py tests/test_fuzzer_agent.py tests/test_cutover_agent.py`). Try to break the AGENTS through this loop: governance bypasses (an agent issuing human-only commands migrate / preserve / deprecate / approve-cutover / rollback - use FakeRoom.agent_says_raw; impersonation via sender_name; a same-named room document created by the wrong agent), malformed commands, mention-hygiene violations that would accidentally address another agent (any '@translator', '@fuzzer', '@cutover-gate' token outside a handoff's leading '@target '), rev/migration mismatches between the three agents, idempotency (re-delivered events, repeated approve-cutover, repeated decisions), restart/rehydration of all three agents from the room documents, error paths that must fail loud with a MARK['error'] message, flaky timing in the test, and tests touching the real targets/modern_fastapi/app/lists.py or fixed ports 9000-9002. Also check the test itself: assertions that could pass vacuously, checks that do not test what they claim. You MAY write extra probing tests in a scratch file tests/test_agents_loop_probe.py (it is NOT merged) to demonstrate defects. Write ONE file, .hacp/reviews/agents_loop.md, with a section headed exactly '## Findings': a numbered list of concrete, REPRODUCED defects only, each with severity (high/medium/low), file:line, the failing scenario (exact room messages / document state and the wrong outcome) and the minimal fix; then '## Verdict'. Do not modify any other file. No style nits.
